fields.description: Issue includes editorials and columns on Coral Gables municipal politics and the resignation of public safety director "Pop" Lehman; commentary on hurricane reporting and civic responses; school and public health discussions including children’s beverages, milk certification/pasteurization, and food-law enforcement; critiques of Miami city administration, police uniform costs, fire department staffing and civil service practices, and street/traffic safety needs. Also contains local gossip/feature columns ("Round the Town" and society items), discussion of Prohibition-era liquor supply and pricing, and assorted local notices and advertisements.
